system.description:
[Safe Move (forced)] the target up to [SR] Squares. The target must move to a Square you are not in. If you do a [Ranged Attack] with [Target: Single] in this main process, gain +1D to [Accuracy] for the attack.

A special skill that repels enemies with the sound of an amulet. The sound resounds unpleasantly in response to hostility, causing the subject to distance themselves from the caster.
